deepseek.peak_window_utc: Monday-Friday 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00, excluding Chinese public holidays
deepseek.cost_reporting: Peak/off-peak bounds unless the applicable billing period can be established; not a bill. No currency conversion.

luna.pricing_conditions: Above 272K input tokens, input and output multipliers are 2 and 1.5; cache writes are billed at 1.25 times uncached input. Record usage detail availability before estimating cost.
luna.background_store_false: Supported; provider temporarily retains response data for asynchronous execution and polling.

identity_scope: Official alias mapping and authenticated model access are recorded alongside response metadata and execution times; no immutable snapshot ID is asserted.
